report: NASA CR3243 May1980, referenced as Ref1 by CR172559
findings: Card2-W documents only XPL,YP,XPT,TWIST,AKODE; no sixth field is specified
Card1-W field6 is WPO crude-grid output switch, whereas later CR4066 field6 is REFAR; this earlier card layout is not directly compatible with F14 input either
PDF155 printed145 defines ZWING as wing height relative to body center; not a verified absolute aircraft WL
conclusion: Do not use either earlier or later generic manual to freeze the F14-specific sixth-field interpretation. Exact F14 implementation remains required.
